notes:
Both B-home and B-route-order complete plus the two mandated B4a-review fixes, strict red-green-refactor. Gate ALL green: tsc clean, lint --max-warnings 0 clean, vitest 728 pass, build OK, size 202.82 kB brotli < 260 kB. CustomerHomePage + RouteOrderPage build to their own chunks with NO Leaflet (verified grep).

F2 (role-aware double-401 redirect): added getFailureRedirectPath() to refresh.ts (returns the module-level failureRedirectPath set by enableSilentRefresh). client.ts's _isRetry double-401 branch now uses `getFailureRedirectPath() ?? '/d/login'` instead of the hardcoded '/d/login'. Driver sets '/d/login', customer sets '/c/login', so a customer whose refresh fails lands on /c/login. Added a customer-context test; the existing driver (/d/login) and dispatcher (/x/login, never enables silent refresh) tests stay green.

F1 (phone everywhere): CallButton no longer returns null. Priority: prop phone → authStorage.getFleetPhone() (new durable key 'fleet.phone', NOT under auth.* and NOT wiped by clear(), since it is public branding and must survive cold/offline launch + logout). If truly unknown, renders a VISIBLE disabled button (styled.button, textSecondary bg) with an i18n callUnavailableAria label — never nothing. useFleetBranding persists the phone inside the queryFn wrapper (TanStack Query v5 has no useQuery onSuccess). New i18n key customer.callUnavailableAria in both locales.

Client fns added (contracts assumed from customer-pwa-work-items.md / handoff-designer.json): getCommonRoutes() → GET routes/common?validNow=true returning { items: CommonRouteDto[] } where CommonRouteDto = { id, name, type, priceCzk } (A-common-routes AC projects exactly these fields; wrapped in { items } per this codebase's ListVehicles/ListDrivers convention — ASSUMED, flag if A-common-routes returns a bare array). getMyActiveOrder() → GET orders/mine/active returning MyActiveOrderDto { id, publicCode, status } or null on 204 (A-my-orders). createOrder reuses the EXISTING postCreateOrder (did NOT fork); useCreateOrder unwraps res.order (the { order } envelope). CreateOrderResponse gained OPTIONAL trackingCode/trackingToken/trackingUrlPath so tsc compiles whether or not A-track merged; navigation uses order.publicCode (authed tracking works without the token since the customer is logged in post-create).

Inline-login form-state preservation (order flow): RouteOrderPage owns ALL form state (passengers/when/note) in local useState and only swaps the SubmitButton ↔ CustomerLoginStep; the page never unmounts, so state survives the login step. On Objednat with no token, showLogin=true renders CustomerLoginStep with onAuthenticated={() => { setShowLogin(false); void submit() }} — it never navigates to /c/login from the flow. Test proves passengers:2 flows through postCreateOrder after completing the phone→code login.

TRAP (added to CLAUDE.md candidate): Windows case-collision. The designer's file list named both whenPicker.ts (pure) and WhenPicker.tsx (component); on case-insensitive Windows FS they collide and `import {WhenPicker} from './WhenPicker'` resolved to the pure module (undefined component → 'Element type is invalid'). Renamed the pure module to whenRules.ts (+ whenRules.test.ts). Also: RouteOrderPage.test.tsx needed `import 'fake-indexeddb/auto'` because the inline-login path calls idbAuthStore.setRefreshToken (indexedDB undefined in jsdom without it); the thrown ReferenceError was swallowed by useCustomerLogin's catch and surfaced as the generic Czech 'unknownError'.

*** TWO CROSS-LANE BLOCKERS FOR B-e2e (AC#1 three-tap real submit) — conductor must reconcile with Lane A: ***
(A) PointToPoint COORD GAP: common-routes returns only { id, name, type, priceCzk } and there is no route-detail endpoint pre-06, but the backend CreateOrder validator REQUIRES non-empty pickupAddress AND non-zero pickup coords. buildRouteOrderRequest therefore sends pickupAddress=route.name and pickupLat/Lng=0 as pre-06 placeholders (loudly commented). A real submit will 400 until Lane A exposes route coords (enrich routes/common for PointToPoint, add a route-detail endpoint, OR relax the validator when routeId is present). This WI is vitest-mocked so it is green regardless; it does NOT block B-route-order, only B-e2e.
(B) CustomerOnly vs AC#1 logged-out routes: A-common-routes is CustomerOnly, but spec AC#1 shows route cards to a FRESH LOGGED-OUT visitor. Because CustomerLayout calls enableSilentRefresh('/c/login') on mount, an ungated logged-out GET routes/common would 401 → silentRefresh (no token) → hard redirect to /c/login, breaking first-time visitors. WORKAROUND: useCommonRoutes + useMyActiveOrder are gated on `authStorage.getAccessToken() !== null` (enabled:hasToken). This is the correct choice TODAY, but *** the hasToken gate on useCommonRoutes MUST be removed/loosened when the contract is reconciled to AllowAnonymous ***, or logged-out visitors will never see routes even after the backend fix. Do not change the gating code until then.

NON-BLOCKING notes (flagged, not fixed): Home's 'Vlastní adresa' navigates to /c/order/new which is owned by B-custom-order (next WI) — a dead nav in the real app until then; the component test passes via its own MemoryRouter route. RouteOrderPage's deep-link fallback (route===null → navigate('/c')) and the logged-out Home path (routes gated off) are untested in this WI. Added a shared money helper web/src/shared/format/money.ts (formatCzk) following the driver HistoryPage precedent (Intl.NumberFormat('cs-CZ').format + ' Kč' plain-space suffix, not currency style, to avoid the NBSP currency-symbol mismatch in tests). Router: added lazy /c/order/route/:routeId child; did NOT add /c/order/new (B-custom-order owns it). All new i18n keys in BOTH cs.json + en.json (parity green), formal Czech 'vy'. Did NOT touch api/** or .claude/state pipeline. Staged web/ only.
